months.note: 10월 초에 와서 늦게는 4월 하순까지 머무는 개체도 있다.

summary: 10월 초에 와서 늦게는 4월 하순까지 머무는 흔한 겨울철새이다. 평지나 산지의 숲에 살며 농경지, 도시, 교외, 구릉, 산지 등 어디서나 눈에 띈다. 곤충과 식물의 씨앗, 열매를 먹는 잡식성이다. 시베리아에서 번식하고 만주 남부, 한국 전역, 일본 서북부, 중국 북부, 타이완 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: hindneck and back with rufous-apricot bases hidden by pale grey-brown fringes
white undertail coverts with rusty bases

art.subject: Naumann's Thrush (Turdus naumanni), adult, as seen in Korea from October to April: crown and upperparts plain brownish-grey, the rufous-apricot feather bases on the hindneck and back hidden by grey-brown fringes; orange-rufous supercilium; ear coverts greyish-brown; throat orange-rufous (whiter in females); breast and flanks heavily scaled and spotted orange-rufous with pale fringes; belly white; undertail coverts white with rusty bases; outer tail feathers rufous-orange, central ones darker brown. Bill dark with a yellow base to the lower mandible. Dark brown eye. Pale brown legs.
art.pose: perched in a fruiting tree, picking berries
art.scene: Korean winter farmland edge with bare trees and a wooded hill; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched: brownish-grey crown and back, orange-rufous supercilium, greyish-brown ear coverts, orange-rufous scaling on the breast and flanks, white belly, rufous outer tail feathers, pale brown legs
adult, undertail detail from below: white undertail coverts with rusty bases, rufous-orange outer tail feathers
art.build: Medium-sized thrush, 23cm, a little shorter than a Brown-eared Bulbul, plump, with an upright stance on the ground. Bill straight, slightly shorter than the head. Legs medium length, pale brown. Wings fairly long. Tail medium length, rufous-orange at the sides, flashing in flight; underwing rufous-orange. Hops and runs on fields and lawns, pausing upright; also eats berries in trees.
avoid: Do not paint a black breast band and black-scaled flanks with a white supercilium — that is Dusky Thrush (Turdus eunomus).
Do not paint a plain, unmarked orange breast like a robin.
Do not paint an all-dark tail without rufous sides.
Do not paint an all-yellow bill like a blackbird.
